keyEvents.text: Goal! Toluca 1, Atlas 0. Helinho (Toluca) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Nicolás Castro.
Alexis Vega (Toluca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Florián Monzón (Atlas).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
